title: Court Support and Legal Processes
description: This module equips specialist DFV practitioners with the knowledge and skills needed to support clients through court processes, protection order applications, and legal pathways. It focuses on preparing clients for court, understanding legal options, and ensuring safety throughout the process.
outcomes: Support clients to understand and navigate DFV-related legal processes
Prepare clients for court in a trauma-informed and safety-focused way
Work effectively with legal services, police, and court stakeholders
